figures.finding: Japanese directors join the Directors Guild of Japan (日本映画監督協会), a cooperative open to anyone who directs for a living in any medium, on a member's recommendation and board approval; joining costs ¥10,000 plus a ¥10,000 capital share (returned on leaving), dues are ¥3,500 a month, and the guild keeps 8% of the additional remuneration it collects as an administration fee.

sources.said: 劇場用映画の監督に限らず、テレビドラマ、ドキュメンタリー、アニメーション、VP、PR、CM、Web等すべての映像媒体における “監督を業とする者”は誰でも入会出来ます。協会員の推薦があればお申込みいただけます。理事会の審査を経て承認されます。 入会時に入会金1万円、出資金1万円を納入していただきます。(出資金は退会時返却) 会費は、月額3,500円です。 この他、映連やＡＴＰとの 団体協約に基づく「映画の二次的利用別追加報酬」の8％を事務代行手数料としてお納めいただき、協会運営費とさせていただきます。
1949年（昭和24年）再建。1950年（昭和25年）中小企業等協同組合法による事業協同組合に改組。

figures.finding: The guild's collective agreements are with the Motion Picture Producers Association of Japan (映連), starting with the 27 December 1971 understanding that sets a minimum fee for theatrical features and additional pay for later uses (with model contracts for staff and freelance directors), followed by memoranda on TV broadcast (1975, 2000), video (1984), CATV (1990), TV films' minimum fee (1992), satellite (1994) and overseas use (2008); a 1993 group contract on TV-film directors' fees and 1993 video memoranda follow, and the guild names its counterparties as 映連 and ATP.

figures.finding: Under the memoranda, a director is paid additional remuneration for each later use of a film: a first terrestrial broadcast pays ¥350,000 (two airings within three years; a second table on the same page says ¥300,000), BS ¥200,000 and CS ¥40,000, then 4% of each later sale; video 1.75% of list price on 80% of units (90% for releases from 1 April 2003); rental 3.35% (business rental and CATV pay-per-view 3.5%); streaming 1.4% of what viewers pay on the producer's own service or 3.5% of the fee from another's; overseas sales 3.5% of revenue after a 25% deduction; a clip in a TV programme ¥24,000.

figures.finding: Since the 1971 revision of the Copyright Act a Japanese film's copyright belongs to the production company, so the director's rights rest on the guild's collective agreements rather than on ownership of the film.

sources.said: １９７１年に著作権法が改正され、「映画の著作権は映画製作会社に帰属する」ということになりました。監督協会では、著作権を獲得する為に著作権法改正運動をすすめていますが、当面は映画製作会社との団体協約の形で権利の拡大・擁護に努めています。
